stem: Which situation describes a non-proportional relationship?

options.label: F
options.text: The circumference of a circle with a radius of x units can be represented by y = 2πx.

options.label: G
options.text: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle with a side length of x units can be represented by y = 3x.

options.label: H
options.text: The total surface area of a cylinder with a radius of 1 unit and height of x units can be represented by y = 2πx + 2π.

options.label: J
options.text: The radius of a circle with a diameter of x units can be represented by y = ½ x.
